text:
Brine samples from the Hadrow Flats survey site averaged 412 milligrams of lithium per litre across 18 test wells, according to preliminary assay results released 14 March 2031.

The finding confirms lithium brine as the mineral resource at the site. The figures appear in the Hadrow Flats Preliminary Assay Report (Report No. HFS-31-07), presented at the Hadrow Flats Survey Consortium's public briefing in Tollamere.

Dr. Perrin Valkoski, lead field geochemist for the Consortium, presented the results. The report covers preliminary assays only, and further testing will be needed before the site's full extent is established.

**What it means for the sector:** A 412 mg/L average across 18 wells gives developers a concrete baseline for early planning. Buyers and investors tracking new lithium supply will now have a published number to measure the site against. Expect attention to turn to how consistent the concentration proves in later sampling.
